places: Laberintos del Norte on Mount Roraima

fields.climate: tropical; hot, humid, moderated by northeast trade winds; two rainy seasons (May to August, November to January)
fields.terrain: mostly rolling highlands; low coastal plain; savanna in south
fields.hazards: flash flood threat during rainy seasons
fields.resources: bauxite, gold, diamonds, hardwood timber, shrimp, fish
fields.farm: rice, sugarcane, plantains, cassava, papayas, pumpkins/squash, chicken, milk, ginger, eggplants
fields.exports: crude petroleum, railway cargo containers, gold, ships, rice
fields.industries: bauxite, sugar, rice milling, timber, textiles, gold mining
fields.languages: English (official), Guyanese Creole, Amerindian languages (including Caribbean and Arawak languages), Indian languages (including Caribbean Hindustani, a dialect of Hindi), Chinese
fields.religions: Protestant 34.8% (Pentecostal 22.8%, Seventh Day Adventist 5.4%, Anglican 5.2%, Methodist 1.4%), Hindu 24.8%, other Christian 20.8%, Roman Catholic 7.1%, Muslim 6.8%, Jehovah's Witness 1.3%…
fields.legal: common law system, based on the English model, with some Roman-Dutch civil law influence
fields.military: 18 years of age or older for voluntary military service; no conscription
